prose: Mark English, aka Eso El, joins InnerVerse to talk about his teachings with Neigong techniques. Tune in to discover the chi condensing power of the dantien, creating the out-of-body consciousness vehicle, retaining individuated memory and awareness after death, becoming a placenta to your next body, psychic & energetic abilities through chi cultivation, and the path to become a player instead of spectator in the game of immortality.
ext: We discuss the three types of chi, ancient Egyptians and original Buddhism as keepers of these chi techniques, the economy of virtue on the soul's journey through lives, germs and generative powers, the origin and fall of humanity, and the periodical renovation of the matrix.
